messages.content: You are a senior code auditor. Review ONLY the code given. Report real defects, not style. Reply with JSON only: {"verdict":"PASS|FAIL","findings":[{"id":"F1","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"quote the exact code","fix":"..."}],"confidence":0.0}. If you cannot quote the code that proves a finding, do not report it.

AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 92 = the integrator's audit of a change to pipeline/telegram.py, the ONE path that sends a finished Pulse Check run to PBX's private approval chat on Telegram (nothing is ever published from it), and to scripts/integrator/check_pin_only.py, the integrator's pre-render check of a sealed pin.
THE ORDER, ruling 115 (2) (orchestrator 13:24 ET Nov 15), verbatim: "MARK IT: a package sealed on the interim bar says so in its record and in the Telegram note in one plain line ("hook passed on the calibrated bar"); PBX's approve or reject of it is appended to the calibration file as a new example (approved = positive, rejected = negative with his reason)." The builder (another session, its own code) now writes the mark into each sealed pin as moments_package["hook_bar"] = {"note": "hook passed on the calibrated bar", "bar": <one line>, "floors": {...}, "calibration_sha256": ..., "ruling": "115"}, OUTSIDE the pin's seal (the seal, moments_package.package_sha256, does not cover it). The builder states that every package it seals from now on carries the mark (no hook opens without passing the calibrated bar); pins sealed before carry none. This change is the Telegram half only.
BACKGROUND (unchanged code):
- deliver_run (telegram.py:266) sends only a run release_auth.authorise passes: ATTESTATION.json verdict ALL_PASS and every BOUND file (release_auth.py:47: the finals, edl.json, manifests, GATE_REPORT.json, VERIFICATION.json, contact sheets) at its attested sha256. It builds EVERY message first (:325, _plan :223, which calls build_caption once per sealed format with the attestation-verified EDL), before the first send and before TELEGRAM_DELIVERY.json is first written (:335). So an exception in build_caption sends nothing.
- build_caption (:106) is each video's caption: head (HOLD_OK ...), the run line ('<run> | 16x9 1920x1080 | 61.0 s'), 'Story: <topic>', 'Clips: <channels>', then optional notes (16:9 ONLY, the 9:16 layout note). When MONITORING rows did not pass, one line is inserted at index 1. _fit (:44) cuts the joined caption to CAPTION_MAX 1024 characters from the END, with a marker (:132).
- PINNED_DECISION.json is written into the run dir by pinned.prepare (pinned.py:848) at render time: {"pin": <the frozen pin, parsed>, "pin_sha256": ..., ...}. It is NOT a bound file (not attested). speaker_lines (:426) already reads it for the publishing kit. pinned.build_edl copies moments_package.package_sha256 into the attested EDL as moments_package_sha256 (pinned.py:716); pinned's schema check requires package_sha256 to be 64 lowercase hex for a moments pin (pinned.py:792). An auto (non-pinned) run has no PINNED_DECISION.json.
- The REVIEW drop (review_texts :722, review_drop :792) sends a run that is NOT authorised, as an engineering review; every text it builds is refused if it carries 'PASS' / 'PASSED' as a word, 'CANDIDATE FOR APPROVAL' or 'approved' (_review_forbidden :639, checked at :851).
THE CHANGE (the diff):
(1) HOOK_BAR_NOTE (:41) = the ruling's line.
(2) hook_bar_mark(mp) (:73): None when the moments_package is not an object or has no "hook_bar" key; HOOK_BAR_NOTE when hook_bar is an object whose "note" is exactly HOOK_BAR_NOTE; ValueError for any other PRESENT value (null, a string, a list, an object with another note or none).
(3) hook_bar_line(run_dir, edl) (:85): None when the run has no PINNED_DECISION.json; else hook_bar_mark of record["pin"]["moments_package"]. An unreadable record (bad JSON, no "pin", a pin that is not an object) or a ValueError -> RuntimeError "STOP: ruling 115 (2) ...". A mark whose record's package_sha256 is not a non-empty string equal to the attested EDL's moments_package_sha256 -> STOP.
(4) build_caption: the line is inserted at index 2 (:124), right under the run line (the monitoring line, when present, is inserted at 1 after it), so _fit's tail cut never reaches it. Every video caption of the drop carries it (each sealed format); the contact sheets and the publishing kit do not. The review drop is unchanged and never carries the line (its wording law refuses 'passed').
(5) check_pin_only.py:42-46: refuses a pin whose mark hook_bar_mark rejects ("hook_bar: ..."), before a render, and names the mark on its READY line (:58). It imports the main tree's pipeline (:12).
TESTS (7 new): test_telegram_delivery.TestHookBarLine (6; real attested runs from make_run; PINNED_DECISION.json written into the run dir): a marked pin's two captions carry the line as line 3, once, never the mark's own text, not in the sheets or the kit, and TELEGRAM_DELIVERY.json records it; the line survives a caption cut whole; an unmarked pin and an auto run carry no line; 8 malformed marks, 3 package mismatches (another digest; both digests missing; both empty) and 5 unreadable records each send nothing and write no delivery record. test_review_drop: a marked pin's review drop goes out complete without the line. On the old code five of the six delivery tests fail (the line; the cut; another package; every subtest of the malformed-mark and unreadable-record tests); the no-mark and review tests pass. Ten mutations each fail a test: the line appended after Clips; the mark's own words printed; any object accepted as the mark; no binding to the EDL; a binding that lets two missing digests match; an unreadable record read as no mark; a null mark read as no mark; the line in the review texts; the line in the publishing kit; an unmarked package printed as marked.
FIND, verifying only from the diff and the cited unchanged lines: (a) any path by which a drop says "hook passed on the calibrated bar" for a run whose pin did not carry the ruling's mark, or for a package other than the one the attested EDL was built from; (b) any path by which a run whose pin carries a valid mark is release-dropped without the line in a video caption, or with the line cut, altered or carrying the mark's own words; (c) any way the change makes an authorised run's release drop, or a review drop, fail or send something it did not send before, other than the STOPs stated in (3); (d) anything in check_pin_only that changes its verdict on a pin without a mark. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings, each with file:line and a concrete failure.

 def _fit(text, limit):
@@ -65,6 +70,39 @@ def snapshot(run_dir, att):
 REGISTRY = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "channels.json")
 
 
+def hook_bar_mark(mp):
+    """Ruling 115 (2): HOOK_BAR_NOTE when a pin's moments_package carries the calibrated hook bar's mark, None when it
+    carries none. A mark that is present must be an object whose "note" is exactly HOOK_BAR_NOTE, else ValueError
+    (never a guess, never the mark's own words). check_pin_only asks this before a render."""
+    if not isinstance(mp, dict) or "hook_bar" not in mp:
+        return None
+    hb = mp["hook_bar"]
+    if not isinstance(hb, dict) or hb.get("note") != HOOK_BAR_NOTE:
+        raise ValueError(f"moments_package hook_bar is not ruling 115 (2)'s mark: {str(hb)[:120]!r}")
+    return HOOK_BAR_NOTE
+
+
+def hook_bar_line(run_dir, edl):
+    """The release caption's ruling 115 (2) line: hook_bar_mark of the pin this run was built from (PINNED_DECISION.json,
+    written by pinned.prepare; not an attested file), bound to the attested EDL by the package digest. None for a run
+    without a pin record (an auto run) or a pin without the mark. STOP (nothing is sent) on an unreadable record, a
+    mark that is not the ruling's, or a marked package that is not the EDL's."""
+    path = os.path.join(run_dir, "PINNED_DECISION.json")
+    if not os.path.exists(path):
+        return None
+    try:
+        with open(path) as f:
+            mp = json.load(f)["pin"].get("moments_package")
+        line = hook_bar_mark(mp)
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"STOP: ruling 115 (2): the pin record cannot say whether the hook was marked "
+                           f"({type(e).__name__}: {e})") from None
+    sha = mp.get("package_sha256") if line else None
+    if line and not (isinstance(sha, str) and sha and sha == edl.get("moments_package_sha256")):
+        raise RuntimeError("STOP: ruling 115 (2): the marked package in PINNED_DECISION.json is not the attested EDL's")
+    return line
+
+
 def build_caption(run_dir, fmt, att, option=None, duration=None, snap=None):
     """The caption of an AUTHORISED run: verdict line first; the MONITORING rows that did not pass are listed as
     reported, not release-deciding (addendum '22:15' item 4). snap: the verified snapshot (deliver_run)."""
@@ -81,7 +119,10 @@ def build_caption(run_dir, fmt, att, option=None, duration=None, snap=None):

              "Clips: " + ", ".join([edl["hook"].get("channel", "?")] + [c.get("channel", "?") for c in edl.get("clips", [])])]
-    if mon:                                  # claude-fable audit batch 16 #1: never 'all passed' with a failure unsaid
+    hb = hook_bar_line(run_dir, edl)         # ruling 115 (2): one plain line, under the run line (never cut by _fit)
+    if hb:
+        lines.insert(2, hb)
+    if mon:                                # claude-fable audit batch 16 #1: never 'all passed' with a failure unsaid
         lines.insert(1, "Monitoring (reported, not release-deciding): " + "; ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in mon.items()))
     if release_auth.release_formats(edl) == ("16x9",):
         lines.append(SIXTEEN_NINE_ONLY)

diff --git a/pipeline/test_telegram_delivery.py b/pipeline/test_telegram_delivery.py
index d39f0272..f6b63814 100644
--- a/pipeline/test_telegram_delivery.py
+++ b/pipeline/test_telegram_delivery.py
@@ -141,6 +141,87 @@ class TestAuthorisedDrop(Base):
         self.assertNotIn("SUGGESTED TITLE: bitcoin", kit)
 
 
+NOTE_115 = "hook passed on the calibrated bar"      # ruling 115 (2)'s words, as PBX must read them
+MARK = {"note": NOTE_115, "bar": "BAR-TEXT scroll>=3 alone>=4 setup>=3", "floors": {"scroll": 3, "alone": 4, "setup": 3},
+        "calibration_sha256": "f" * 64, "ruling": "115"}
+PKG = "ab" * 32
+NO_MARK = object()
+
+
+class TestHookBarLine(Base):
+    """Ruling 115 (2) (orchestrator 13:24 ET Nov 15): a package sealed on the calibrated hook bar says so in the
+    Telegram note in one plain line. The pin carries the mark in moments_package["hook_bar"] (outside the seal); the
+    run's PINNED_DECISION.json (pinned.prepare) holds that pin and is not an attested file, so the mark counts only
+    for the package the attested EDL was built from."""
+
+    def marked_run(self, mark=MARK, record_sha=PKG, edl_sha=PKG, topic=None, raw=None):
+        edl = json.load(open(os.path.join(make_run(self.tmp, attest=False), "edl.json")))
+        if edl_sha is not None:
+            edl["moments_package_sha256"] = edl_sha
+        if topic:
+            edl["topic"] = topic
+        rd = make_run(self.tmp, edl=edl)
+        mp = {"type": "moments", "package_sha256": record_sha}
+        if mark is not NO_MARK:
+            mp["hook_bar"] = mark
+        with open(os.path.join(rd, "PINNED_DECISION.json"), "w") as f:
+            f.write(raw if raw is not None else json.dumps({"mode": "pinned", "pin": {"moments_package": mp}}))
+        return rd
+
+    def refused(self, rd, needle):
+        sent = []
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, needle):
+            TG.deliver_run(rd, send=lambda kind, path, fields, data=None: sent.append(kind) or len(sent))
+        self.assertEqual(sent, [])                                    # nothing reached the chat
+        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(os.path.join(rd, "TELEGRAM_DELIVERY.json")))
+
+    def test_a_marked_pin_says_so_in_one_plain_line_under_the_run_line(self):
+        rd = self.marked_run()
+        _, sent = self.deliver(rd)
+        vids = [s for s in sent if s[0] == "video"]
+        self.assertEqual(len(vids), 2)
+        for s in vids:                                                # every video's note, each format
+            lines = s[2]["caption"].split("\n")
+            self.assertEqual(lines[2], NOTE_115, lines)                # head, run line, then the ruling's line
+            self.assertEqual(sum(NOTE_115 in l for l in lines), 1)
+            self.assertNotIn("BAR-TEXT", s[2]["caption"])               # never the mark's own words
+        for s in sent:
+            if s[0] != "video":                                        # one line in the note: not the sheets or kit
+                self.assertNotIn(NOTE_115, json.dumps(s[2]))
+        written = json.load(open(os.path.join(rd, "TELEGRAM_DELIVERY.json")))
+        self.assertEqual([NOTE_115 in m["caption"] for m in written["messages"] if "format" in m], [True, True])
+
+    def test_the_line_survives_a_caption_cut_whole(self):
+        rd = self.marked_run(topic="Bitcoin " * 300)                   # the story alone is past CAPTION_MAX
+        _, sent = self.deliver(rd)
+        cap = sent[0][2]["caption"]
+        self.assertTrue(cap.endswith("...(see GATE_REPORT)"), cap[-40:])
+        self.assertLessEqual(len(cap), TG.CAPTION_MAX)
+        self.assertIn(NOTE_115, cap.split("\n"))
+
+    def test_no_mark_or_no_pin_record_no_line(self):
+        for rd in (self.marked_run(mark=NO_MARK), make_run(self.tmp)):   # an unmarked pin; an auto run (no record)
+            _, sent = self.deliver(rd)
+            for s in sent:
+                self.assertNotIn("calibrated bar", json.dumps(s[2]))
+
+    def test_a_mark_that_is_not_the_rulings_sends_nothing(self):
+        for mark in ({"note": "hook passed"}, {"note": NOTE_115.upper()}, {"note": NOTE_115 + " (and approved)"},
+                     {"bar": "x"}, None, NOTE_115, [NOTE_115], {}):
+            with self.subTest(mark=mark):
+                self.refused(self.marked_run(mark=mark), r"STOP: ruling 115 \(2\).*not ruling 115 \(2\)'s mark")
+
+    def test_a_mark_on_another_package_sends_nothing(self):
+        self.refused(self.marked_run(record_sha="cd" * 32), r"not the attested EDL's")
+        self.refused(self.marked_run(record_sha=None, edl_sha=None), r"not the attested EDL's")   # no digest at all
+        self.refused(self.marked_run(record_sha="", edl_sha=""), r"not the attested EDL's")
+
+    def test_an_unreadable_pin_record_sends_nothing(self):
+        for raw in ("{not json", '{"mode": "pinned"}', '{"pin": []}', '{"pin": null}', "[]"):
+            with self.subTest(raw=raw):
+                self.refused(self.marked_run(raw=raw), r"STOP: ruling 115 \(2\): the pin record cannot say")
+
+
 class TestNothingIsSentUnlessAuthorised(Base):
     def refused(self, rd, label, needle):
         """Nothing sent, for THIS reason (cycle 2 F8: any RuntimeError is not enough)."""
